user_scope: 固定周度H5；个股训练标签改H5；D/F/T/P单列；预测下一交易日的周风格。
partition: frozen weekly-h5 style4; no reclustering, no smoothing, six sessions from last weekly signal to realization

stock.target: raw adjusted close(t+6)/close(t+1)-1; v5 old per-day equal-count deciles fixed affine encoding using actual H5 eligible universe
stock.training_boundary: include only original allowed training dates, H5 target exit and frozen weekly style ready_date <=2020-07-31; matched H5 control is exact union of style rows
stock.features_weights_params: original 164 features, M0 weights and v5 hyperparameters including 200 max rounds, patience50. Top5×H5 net_ann on own style dates (ALL across dates) with complete 1448-session turnover context.
stock.evaluation: unchanged official Top3×H5 daily cross-section zscore 5-seed blend and H5 RankIC; own-style versus frozen v5 main, matched H5 reference and prior H20 experts re-scored on original 4 labels diagnostic; money figures annualized within style, no automatic promotion
stock.criterion: strict positive same-date delta on both net_ann and net_sharpe for each style. RankIC, paired seeds, period robustness, uncertainty of five P weeks separately.

classifier.features: Frozen 361 historical features available at t close plus as-of weekly market path, lagged end-of-holding returns available by t, last matured weekly factors, and already observable partial fixed-basket returns; no unconfirmed labels. Core=26 historical compact variables plus new weekly observations.
classifier.target: features at t close, actual next trading day u; y=raw weekly style4 at u; first/last signal and target dates both inside split. Training only with weekly ready_date <=2020-07-31.
classifier.asof: Date-only bars at close; no external data with unverified publication timestamps; no use of future outcome or intervening last-week label as feature before ready_date.
classifier.recipe: Existing LGBM multiclass depth5/15 leaves, sqrt_inverse class frequencies calculated in train; 1000 round cap, multi_logloss early stopping patience50 on historical eval directly; one prefix at 50 rounds of the same trajectory with no eval-selected iterations as sensitivity. Logistic as frozen linear comparator, original C=0.1, median/scale learned in train, five seeds. All five probability vectors arithmetic averaged in D,F,T,P order; argmax, no threshold tuning or model choice based on test.
controls: persistence of most recently fully matured weekly label available on signal date
evaluation: first tradable target of each week vs later targets
within-eval maturity sensitivity and P event hits
bootstrap by contiguous blocks of 8 weeks
classifier.data_version_classifier: historical frozen 2026-11-06 source stock panel, effective quote panel through 2026-09-30 used only per as-of available endpoints, same historical inputs as frozen weekly H5

status_backend: Both original native protocols are closed. The native classifier only supports monthly-k4-next-day-v1 and matching inner receipts. This bounded supplement owns weekly no-inner classifier starts in docs/stage-state.json and stock starts in experts/docs/expert-state.json under one parent.
limitations: Evaluation also used for early stopping; historical selection study.
Economic cluster naming reference uses historical full series. Expert H5 maturity, member eligibility and own-style ES differ from original v5; H5 full control and H20 old expert bridge reported.
P concentrated in few weeks, report raw counts and leave-week sensitivity.
Classifier date target and stock signal dates have distinct roles and coverage.
